title: Martin Gardner finds his own lost book

tellings.quote: One day Martin was perusing a used bookstore when he came across a familiar title.

plain: A writer named Martin Gardner was browsing a used bookstore one day and came across a familiar title: a copy of his own book, one he had lost. The skeptic Michael Shermer tells the story on the show as a striking coincidence, and mentions Persi Diaconis and Frederick Mosteller alongside it. He tells it to show that coincidences this strange really do happen.
